source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: (ChatGPT OR "large language models" OR "large language model") AND (society OR labour OR labor OR policy OR ethics OR governance)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:(ChatGPT OR "large language models" OR "large language model") AND (society OR labour OR labor OR policy OR ethics OR governance),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("ChatGPT" OR "large language model" OR "large language models") AND ("ethics" OR "governance" OR "labor" OR "labour" OR "policy" OR "society"))
